statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and I49.9
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to continuously correlate rhythm with daily activities and capture potential arrhythmic events
